selection_policy: Prefer one small periodic model with a physically extended covalent solid and a second physically distinct ionic solid. Request actual periodic SCF only after resource admission, and do not rank different compositions by their absolute total energies. Choose the lower-electron-count candidate first while treating this as a rough cost preference, not a physical discovery score.
why_not_molecular_repeat: The World has already demonstrated bounded molecular quantum calculation and feedback. These candidates add distinct three-dimensional extended lattices with different bonding regimes; they are material construction requests, not prewritten per-material solver branches.
